title: FinitePresentationIntegralFiltration
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme and F a finitely presented O_X-module. There are m >= 0 and an increasing chain c of subobjects of F, indexed by Fin(m+1), starting at zero and ending at F. For each consecutive quotient, there are an integral scheme Z, a closed immersion i:Z -> X and a quasi-coherent ideal I of O_Z (represented by IdealSheafData) such that the quotient is isomorphic to i_* I. No nonzero or coherence clauses on the output are needed.

proof.text: Let P be the predicate that an O_X-module is isomorphic to the pushforward of a quasi-coherent ideal on an integral closed subscheme. P is invariant under isomorphism by composing witnesses. Let S(G) be the closure of its nonzero-stalk support, regarded as a Closeds X.

Use well-founded induction on Closeds X, available for the Noetherian underlying space. The induction assertion for T is: every finitely presented G with S(G) contained in T has a finite P-filtration. Apply the support-reduction filtration lemma to G. Each quotient either satisfies P or is finitely presented with S(Q) strictly below S(G). In the latter case S(Q) is strictly below T by transitivity, so apply the induction hypothesis at S(Q).

Apply finite_filtration_refinement with P and its isomorphism invariance to the coarse chain, using the recursively supplied filtrations for smaller-support factors. This gives the required P-filtration of G. Evaluate the induction assertion at S(F), using reflexive containment, to obtain the unchanged theorem statement.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finitePresentation_integral_filtration
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (c : Fin (m + 1) → Subobject F) (hc : Monotone c),
      c 0 = ⊥ ∧ c (Fin.last m) = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ j : Fin m, ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ X),
        IsClosedImmersion i ∧ IsIntegral Z ∧
        ∃ I : Z.IdealSheafData,
          Nonempty (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (c j.castSucc) (c j.succ)
            (hc j.castSucc_le_succ)) ≅ (pushforward i).obj I.toModules)
